# Pre Amp Coffee Studio

> Pre Amp is a coffee-and-vinyl listening bar in Squirrel Hill, Pittsburgh,
> serving specialty espresso, pourovers, and light food alongside records
> spinning all day. Part of the RD Restaurants group.

Location: 5840 Forbes Ave, Pittsburgh, PA 15217 · Phone: (412) 555-0142
Hours: Mon–Fri 7:00 AM–6:00 PM · Sat 8:00 AM–7:00 PM · Sun 8:00 AM–5:00 PM
